newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar futures slip late to close lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar futures slip late to close lower.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures lost ground late to close lower after a routine day on Wednesday, traders said.
At the 1730 GMT close front month August was $1.70 lower at $310.50 on volume was 1,711, by far the most active month.

London was more or less sidelined with price direction coming from New York as traders focused there on the liquidation of the high open interest in May ahead of the contract's expiry after Wednesday's close.
In Paris, the August contract went out down $0.40 at $311.70 and October was down $0.50 at $304.50.
